rateLimits.note: Trakt allows 500 GET calls every 5 minutes per client ID and public IP for unauthenticated calls (UNAUTHED_API_GET_LIMIT; 500 per 5 minutes per user when authenticated): written as 100 a minute, the schema having no 5-minute window. Writes (1 a second per user) are not made by this provider. The X-Ratelimit header (Trakt's JSON) is not read; a 429's Retry-After is.

attribution.text: This application uses Trakt but is not endorsed or certified by Trakt.

provenance.notes: Standard API access is free for commercial and non-commercial use with no separate agreement (API use policy, 2026-10-20); selling access or datasets, scraping, mirroring the catalogue and redistributing it as a feed are not allowed. No fixed maximum cache duration; images must be cached, not hotlinked; nothing kept once the integration ends. The credit "[App name] uses Trakt but is not endorsed or certified by Trakt" goes on an About, Settings or credits page, not beside each item; the logo is optional (app.trakt.tv/branding). Required headers: trakt-api-key, trakt-api-version 2, and a User-Agent naming the application and its version ("MyAppName/1.0.0"). Applications unused for 30 days are deleted. Premium (apiz.trakt.tv) has higher limits, not stated.
